expectation_policy: Frozen Oracle literals and full pinned Java/selected mechanics were read before scenario authoring. Engine privacy/transaction/owned-branch contracts are separate.
validation: Only focused D prefix;10s/test,30s/group; no games, bots, per-action game/action cloning, replay or serialized observations. Final combined runtime and required gates remain separate.
helper_scope: Selected directly relevant mechanics complete; cached transitive interfaces/abstract/filter packages are not blanket-read or acceptance claims. SquirrelToken is additionally pinned in the local source receipt.

source_discrepancies.fact: Frozen XMage inventory has no implementation; no Java pin is invented. Oracle and CR707 control its copy exceptions.
Java early return when source is absent is not followed; CR113.7a requires independent resolution, exercised by source-exile parity case.
Primary analogous targeting reasoning for changing total-MV relations is an inference; this bounded module asserts legal current pair and source-duration behavior, not the disputed changing-MV edge.

explicit_evidence_limits: Shared B combat references must be present and pass in final source union; they are not claimed executed in this isolated D checkout.
The changing-total-MV resolution edge for Civil War remains outside this bounded subset; no assertion or acceptance claim is made for that edge.
This is clause/scenario assurance, not exhaustive interaction enumeration or a natural-game corpus.
